name: Rewind
description: In a busy square everything plays backward while the subject walks forward through it.

wardrobe.man: a mustard yellow coat and dark clothes
wardrobe.woman: a mustard yellow coat and dark clothes
wardrobe.person: a mustard yellow coat and dark clothes

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} walks toward the camera across a busy old town square in the morning, mid-stride, wearing {wardrobe}. A stone fountain sprays water behind {them}, pigeons peck on the cobblestones, and a few passers-by in muted colors cross the square in different directions. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered and sharp, full body visible. Cinematic photography, soft morning sunlight from the left, warm muted tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain facades with blank shop windows throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY walks slowly backward, away from the camera, stepping back heel first with calm even steps and facing the camera the whole time, eyes on a point just past the camera. Around {them} the square moves forward at normal speed: the flock of pigeons bursts up off the cobblestones and flies away over the rooftops, a passer-by drops a stack of papers that scatter across the stones in the wind, the fountain sprays high into the air and splashes back into the basin, and people walk past in both directions. The camera dollies slowly forward, keeping the {subject} the same size in frame. Sound: a burst of wings flapping, papers rustling, splashing fountain water, footsteps and the murmur of a busy square. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, natural motion and physics, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame walks slowly backward, away from the camera, stepping back heel first and facing the camera, while everything around {them} keeps moving forward at normal speed: birds take off, loose papers and leaves blow away, water splashes, people walk past. The camera dollies slowly forward. Sound: wings flapping, rustling papers, footsteps. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, natural motion and physics, sharp detail, stable picture.
